facts.title: Oasis and Ratchet fishing
facts.location: Forgotten Pools, Stagnant Oasis, Lushwater Oasis; Ratchet docks
facts.note: From Classic: Longjaw Mud Snapper, Bristle Whisker Catfish and Deviate Fish in the oases. Forever lists no fishing trainer in the Barrens; Journeyman (level 10, skill 50) is Lumak in Orgrimmar. Cooking trainer Duhng is east of the Crossroads.
